source_text: Lex naturalis a Deo digito suo in cordibus scripta semina veritatis praebet; quae si bene excolamus, fructum vitae afferent in Christo Iesu, cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Law natural by God with-finger his in hearts written seeds of-truth offers; which if well we-cultivate, fruit of-life they-will-bring in Christ Jesus, to-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The natural law God wrote with his finger on hearts gives seeds of truth; if we cultivate them well, they bear fruit of life in Christ Jesus, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
